project.description: Project name. Names the image agentic-<project>:local and the workspace directory.

layout.description: What /work is: single (the project root is one git repository) or multi (git repositories in its direct subfolders). Written by agentic init; agentic run needs it.

target.description: multi only: the default repository agentic run starts the agent in, a direct subfolder of the project root. agentic target NAME sets it.

targets.description: Default --target of every setup line: the harnesses that assets, plugins, marketplaces and MCP servers go to.

base_image.description: Image the derived image is built FROM: the base or an overlay built FROM the base.

tools.description: Build-time tools. Changing them needs agentic build.

additionalProperties.description: A preset provided by an overlay: false or a version.

java.description: JDK majors, installed side by side under /opt/java/<v>; 21 is always present. default sets JAVA_HOME.

node.description: Node majors, side by side under /opt/node/<v>; 22 is always present. default goes first on PATH.

gradle.description: System Gradle version (exact). The wrapper (./gradlew) is the norm; false installs none.

extra_dockerfile.description: Dockerfile lines appended to the derived image, run as root, inside .agentic/.

on_start.description: Script run as dev at every container start, with the full environment.

on_start_required.description: When true, a failing on_start stops the container.

default.description: Agent of agentic run without --agent, and of agentic setup.

socket.description: Mount the host Docker socket. It is host root; off by default. Changing it needs agentic build.

apps.description: Applications the task container can run, each in tmux window app-<name>, controlled through the bridge (agentic-app, the UI). Keys per app: run, ports, url, dir, env, env_files, prepare, teardown, autostart, idle_stop. Changing them needs agentic build. At most 32 apps.

run.description: The command, run with bash -lc in dir of the checkout; it should stay in the foreground.

ports.description: Container ports the app listens on (1-65535, at most 16, none shared with another app, not the bridge's 8765); may be empty. The server must listen on 0.0.0.0.

dir.description: Working directory relative to the checkout. Default the checkout.

env.description: Plain values exported to prepare, run and teardown. Keys match ^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$; a key naming a token, key, secret or password is refused: such values belong in .env.

env_files.description: Files copied into the checkout before the first start: from is relative to .agentic/, to relative to the checkout; neither has .. or starts with /.

prepare.description: Runs once before the first start (e.g. npm ci); a failure keeps the app from starting.

autostart.description: Start the app when the task starts. Default false.

idle_stop.description: Stop the app after this long without traffic on its ports: 30m, 1h, 0 (never). Default 0.

setup.description: The container's setup as agentic commands without the agentic prefix (docs/setup.md): add marketplace|plugin|mcp|skill|agent|command|workspace, copy, mount, volume. Replayed in order by agentic build and the start.
